Sandbox_ISIL_ExtendedMode_tooltip: Enables configurable suppression strength and optional suppressor durability. Disabled by default to preserve the original mod balance.
Sandbox_ISIL_EnableDurability_tooltip: Suppressors lose durability whenever the weapon is fired and are destroyed when exhausted. Only applies while Extended Realism Mode is enabled.
Sandbox_ISIL_CaliberBasedWear_tooltip: Adjusts suppressor wear by ammunition caliber. Small calibers consume less durability, while rifle and shotgun ammunition consume more. Unknown ammunition uses the standard 9mm wear rate.
Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalNoiseReduction_: Percentage reduction applied to firearm sound radius and volume in Extended Realism Mode.

Sandbox_ISIL_ProfessionalDurability_tool: Number of 9mm-equivalent shots before a professional suppressor is destroyed.
